story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed for the changed shots. A tower camera's display pans dry land and pulls back to the tower. 16 of 56 cameras are up. Smoke appears in the display and is flagged. An alert card leaves the display, runs low to a crew truck and lands on its dash phone. The dash clock marks an estimated window of up to ten minutes. In the display the plume keeps burning and the cameras don't prevent fires. Wide, the beam reaches the plume on open land left of the tower while a dashed line runs low from the truck's landed alert and stops short of a station's badge. The utility's wildfire lead reports no major fire since launch over the visor calendar. The record stays blank. The plan waits on state approval.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees and ends on the alert landed with the crew, the line to responders open and the plan awaiting approval, with no implied well fire.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4-shot-2 to s5-shot-1: from the dash clock in the cab straight back into the lens display with no physical bridge.
